payload.core_mechanism_summary: Case analysis on max cost mod 3, using 3-value coins greedily and adjusting for remainders by checking for 1-value items and close-call thresholds to reduce coin count.
payload.rationale: The algorithm starts by taking as many 3-value coins as max/3, then handles remainder 1 or 2 by possibly trading a 3 for two 2s or a 3 and a 1 for two 2s, reflecting exchange arguments typical of coin-change greedy proofs.
